title: surface-code-decoder-priors: code, result tables and number-verification script for "When Calibration Helps Surface-Code Matching Decoders"

creators.name: Dong, Liang
creators.affiliation: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Baylor University, Waco, Texas, USA

description:
Simulation code, experiment runners, seeded run manifests, analysis scripts and the complete result tables behind the manuscript When Calibration Helps Surface-Code Matching Decoders, together with the verification script that recomputes every number quoted in the paper from those tables and fails on any mismatch.

The study measures when fitting a matching decoder's prior from syndrome data helps and when it hurts: exact logical risk for short surface-code memories, a branch-and-bound bound over a continuous family of per-class priors, the calibration-budget frontier under per-qubit heterogeneity, the population limit of the pairwise correlation estimator, and a prior-versus-decoder factorial on Google's public Willow release.

The bit-packed per-shot outcome records, which are needed only to recompute the paired statistics shot by shot, are deposited separately; see the related identifiers. The Willow hardware release itself is not redistributed here and is public at Zenodo record 13273331.
